item.title: evans: universal gRPC client demonstration
item.description: In this post, I am going to write demo for a tool which I have just met, it is called Evans. It is basically universal gRPC client. What it means ? Basically when you have gRPC server and would like to test gRPC calls without creating client, you can test server side calls with Evans. It is known that gRPC is very common communication method between microservices, it can be used for internal and external communication. I do not have intention to explain what gRPC is in this post since it is not the purpose. If required documentation of gRPC can be investigated.
